reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited text supports it: Section 2(a) grants only a non-exclusive licence and expressly confirms Client is not obligated to use the Interface and remains free to acquire, develop or licence competing software/services — the preferred position (no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer).

The only sourcing tie (Section 3(i), p0042) requires a TrueLink credit report solely for borrowers underwritten through a System using the Interface; it is use-contingent, confined to a single narrow product category, and does not restrict Client's general procurement, so it sits at or above the fallback rather than being exclusive dealing for the full term.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was proposed (rendered text is identical to the original) and no counterparty comment was generated; the deterministic check confirming no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer passes.

Rationale correctly notes the sub-element (the Section 3(i) tie and the separate Non-Competition Agreement) for information only rather than flagging it, which matches the playbook's classification semantics; retaining this as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue is appropriate.
